note: #834 QUALITY-15 model-profiles manifest (mirrors configs/fleet-driver.json + configs/opencode-version-pin.json: flat JSON, one long note, DORMANT by default, fail-soft reads). Per-model attributes the BlarAI-side dispatch/swap/oracle/gate machinery reads so the harness can branch on model ARCHITECTURE/FAMILY, not just task complexity. SUPERSET of opencode.json's provider.local.models block (which opencode itself consumes); the overlapping fields (tool_call, reasoning, limit.context, limit.output) MUST agree with this file and with the hand-wired values in scripts/start-llm.ps1 (tool_parser, the resident-GB table, the MoE env) -- two gate checks assert it: blarai tests/integration/test_model_profiles_ssot.py (Python) and scripts/verify-model-profiles.ps1 (this repo). TWO TABLES: 'models' = STABLE per-model attributes (arch/params/quant/serving_backend/tool_call_format/thinking_mode/grammar/context/cost_profile/resident_gb + the model's CARD-RECOMMENDED sampling -- reference data, NOT what any call-site runs today); 'call_sites' = the per-ROLE overlay DESCRIBING TODAY's actual policy (the same 14B is GREEDY in-proc as planner/oracle_author but 0.7-on-OVMS as coder -- policy cannot live purely per-model). FAIL-SOFT: an unknown served-model id falls back to 'defaults'; a missing field falls back to that field's conservative default; a MISSING or MALFORMED file degrades to today's hard-coded behavior and never crashes a consumer. 'arch' and 'serving_backend' are SEPARATE fields even though today they are 1:1 (coder-30b->ovms, 14B->inproc+ovms) so the day they decouple nothing silently mis-branches. DORMANCY / ROLLOUT: nothing reads this file until each consumer explicitly adopts a field, each adoption its own reviewed change. The ONLY field consumed as of #834 is models.<assistant-role model>.reasoning_strip.hidden_block_tags -- the AO brain's <think>/<tool_call> strip binding (entrypoint.py + gpu_inference.py), which resolves to the byte-identical historical regex when this file is absent. SAMPLING-POLICY ADOPTION (killing the greedy anti-pattern the model cards warn against, dossier docs/handoffs/research-model-profiles-20260711.md sec 2/6.1) is EXPLICITLY NOT wired here -- it waits for #835's A1 greedy-vs-low-temp battery data and the LA's CLAUDE.md 'deterministic = temperature=0' doctrine call. call_sites.*.sampling_today therefore records what runs NOW (greedy for the in-proc 14B), never a recommendation. Changing a field is an LA/coordinator go-live step, never a silent edit.
